at you. The undead horde charges.

Called Guardian Spirits due to primitive cultures' belief that they were the spirits of the dead come back to life, these creatures are actually parasites with telekinetic abilities. Each Guardian Spirit Parasite can inhabit one corpse at a time (as the statistics, below), giving the body a semblance of undead animation. Simultaneously, each Guardian Spirit Parasite can also reanimate other corpses without actually being in their bodies (
), but they do so less efficiently, and only to help kill the heroes.
The Guardian Spirit Parasite cannot live outside of a host body for long. If the heroes kill a host body, its parasite inhabits one of the remaining
, turning it into a Guardian Spirit Parasite. If there are no
close enough to inhabit, the Guardian Spirit Parasite has nowhere to go and is destroyed.
These cadavers are actually made up of two distinct groups: the salvagers known as

, who had been out to capture Jedi survivors of the orbital bombardment. The two parties ran into each other in the academy library and wound up killing each other in the archive room. Now, controlled by the Guardian Spirit Parasite like string puppets, their skeletal remains remember nothing of their former lives.
